title: Frontend from screenshot/Figma
whenToUse: Implement UI matching design within design-system constraints.
whenNotToUse: No design reference and you invent branding.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Implement UI for {{screen}} matching design.

CONTEXT:
Tokens/components: {{system}}.

INPUT:
Reference: {{reference}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Reuse existing components
- a11y labels
- No new CSS framework

OUTPUT:
Component structure + a11y notes

ACCEPTANCE:
Visual + keyboard checks listed.

VERIFICATION:
Manual checklist.
badPrompt: Make it pretty like the screenshot.
improvedPrompt: Build pricing section using existing Button/Stack; match spacing tokens; include focus states.
privacySecurityNotes: Do not upload confidential client screenshots to public models if policy forbids
